description: Cover Parameters.swift rejection paths by driving Parameter.set directly

asi.finding: MAJOR: throwing anywhere inside a render/compute pass aborts the process (SIGABRT). The pass's workloadExit never runs, the encoder is released without endEncoding, Metal asserts in -[_MTLCommandEncoder dealloc]. Filed #357.
asi.technique: Error paths that throw mid-pass CANNOT be tested through OffscreenRenderer/Runner - the test process dies. Instead build an MTLRenderCommandEncoder/MTLComputeCommandEncoder in the test, get a Reflection from device.makeRenderPipelineState(descriptor:options:.bindingInfo), call Parameter.set(on:reflection:) directly, and end the encoder in a defer.
asi.gotcha: device.makeComputePipelineState(function:options:) resolves to the async overload; use the descriptor form to get reflection synchronously.
asi.parameters_swift: 27 -> 13 uncovered. What is left is preconditionFailure traps (ambiguous parameter, encoder mismatch) which cannot be tested, and the missing-reflection throw which needs the element tree and so is blocked on #357.

asi.technique: A generic Probe<Value> element that reads any keypath via @MSEnvironment and reports a match into a leaf element is a cheap way to assert environment modifiers without touching Node internals - see EnvironmentModifierTests.Probe

description: Cover MSAA modifier early-outs and the verbose logging gate

asi.covered: MSAAModifier.setupEnter's three early-outs (sampleCount<=1, no renderPassDescriptor, colourless descriptor) driven through System.update+processSetup with no renderer at all; Logger.verbose gate via SystemEnvironment task-local
asi.technique: For elements whose setup only reads the environment, System().update(root:) + processSetup() is far cheaper and more precise than rendering - no encoder, no drawable, and error paths do not risk the #357 abort
asi.diminishing_returns: Error.swift's remaining 12 are all fatalError bodies; StateBox's are assertionFailure/preconditionFailure; System+Snapshot's is an unreachable Mirror fallback; Parameters' are preconditionFailure traps. These cannot be covered without changing library code, and should be left alone.

description: Host RenderView through ViewInspector's ViewHosting, plus the no-System body path

asi.big_win: ViewHosting.host(view:size:) actually instantiates the SwiftUI view tree, so RenderView's body, RenderViewHelper's update closure, ViewModelBox and ViewAdaptor's makeNSView/updateNSView all run. +113 covered lines from one small test - by far the best return of the session.
asi.why_it_works: Everything behind a SwiftUI body or a Representable is unreachable by constructing values; it needs a host. ViewInspector's ViewHosting provides one without a window server.
asi.pattern: ViewHosting.host(view: v, size: CGSize(...)); defer { ViewHosting.expel() }. Expelling should also drive the dismantle path.
